comparison: S37 deep, S64 shallow, S65 deep provide distinct consecutive kinds over nearly two half cycles. S12/S93 reproduce shallow kind and S37/S65 reproduce deep kind. P/2 timestamps alone would alternate ~90 and ~60 ppt eclipse depths, whereas Gaia SB1 period and two-kind geometry favor the full P. The partial S11 and distorted S38 are not clock anchors.
limitation: This excludes a simple same-kind P/2 interpretation, not all exotic alternation mechanisms; no exhaustive harmonic search.
